mapper.select: /*selectMasterMpVoDashBoardList*/ SELECT (SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM V_VOC_ICOMLUSR WHERE COM_CODE = 'KRKORE0001' AND USER_ID = X.DS_USER_ID AND SYS_TYPE='KA') DDS_USER_NAME, X.TOT_CNT, (X.DATE_0+X.DATE_1+X.DATE_2+X.DATE_3) AS T_DATE, X.DS_USER_ID, X.DS_DEPT FROM ( SELECT A.DS_USER_ID, (NVL(SUM(DECODE(ROUND(SYSDATE-A.CD_DATE,0),1,1)),0)+ NVL(SUM(DECODE(ROUND(SYSDATE-A.CD_DATE,0),2,1)),0)) AS DATE_0, (NVL(SUM(DECODE(ROUND(SYSDATE-A.CD_DATE,0),3,1)),0)+ NVL(SUM(DECODE(ROUND(SYSDATE-A.CD_DATE,0),4,1)),0)) AS DATE_1, (NVL(SUM(DECODE(ROUND(SYSDATE-A.CD_DATE,0),5,1)),0)+ NVL(SUM(DECODE(ROUND(SYSDATE-A.CD_DATE,0),6,1)),0)) AS DATE_2, (NVL(SUM(DECODE(ROUND(SYSDATE-A.CD_DATE,0),0,1)),0)+ NVL(SUM(DECODE(ROUND(SYSDATE-A.CD_DATE,0),7,1)),0)) AS DATE_3, COUNT(A.VC_NO) AS TOT_CNT, A.DS_DEPT FROM KEPAVCDT A WHERE A.RECV_FLAG IN ('DC','PS') AND A.DS_USER_ID = #{st_user_id} GROUP BY A.DS_DEPT, A.DS_USER_ID ) X

/*getDashBoardList1*/ SELECT DS_DEPT_NAME, SUM(LAST_MONTH_CNT) AS LAST_MONTH_CNT, SUM(THIS_MONTH_CNT) AS THIS_MONTH_CNT, SUM(WEEK_CNT) AS WEEK_CNT, ROUND(SUM(LAST_MONTH)/DECODE(SUM(LAST_MONTH_CNT),0,1,SUM(LAST_MONTH_CNT)),0) AS LAST_MONTH, ROUND(SUM(THIS_MONTH)/DECODE(SUM(THIS_MONTH_CNT),0,1,SUM(THIS_MONTH_CNT)),0) AS THIS_MONTH, ROUND(SUM(WEEK)/DECODE(SUM(WEEK_CNT),0,1,SUM(WEEK_CNT)),0) AS WEEK FROM ( SELECT (SELECT TEXT1 FROM V_VOC_ICOMCOD2 WHERE COMPANY_CODE = 'KRKORE0001' AND TYPE = 'C001' AND CODE = DS_DEPT AND SYS_TYPE='KA') AS DS_DEPT_NAME, DECODE(TO_CHAR(CD_DATE,'YYYYMM'),B.LAST_MONTH,NVL(ROUND(DF_DATE-CD_DATE,0),0),0) AS LAST_MONTH, DECODE(TO_CHAR(CD_DATE,'YYYYMM'),B.LAST_MONTH,1,0) AS LAST_MONTH_CNT, DECODE(TO_CHAR(CD_DATE,'YYYYMM'),TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMM'),NVL(ROUND(DF_DATE-CD_DATE,0),0),0) AS THIS_MONTH, DECODE(TO_CHAR(CD_DATE,'YYYYMM'),TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMM'),1,0) AS THIS_MONTH_CNT, CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(CD_DATE,'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN B.FROM_WEEK AND B.TO_WEEK THEN NVL(ROUND(DF_DATE-CD_DATE,0),0) ELSE 0 END AS WEEK, CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(CD_DATE,'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN B.FROM_WEEK AND B.TO_WEEK THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS WEEK_CNT, DS_DEPT FROM KEPAVCDT A, ( SELECT TO_CHAR(LAST_DAY(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, -1)),'YYYYMM') AS LAST_MONTH , TO_CHAR(TRUNC(SYSDATE+2) - TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'D'),'YYYYMMDD') AS FROM_WEEK, TO_CHAR(TRUNC(SYSDATE+2) - TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'D') + 6.99999421,'YYYYMMDD') AS TO_WEEK FROM DUAL) B, ( SELECT CODE FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'VC01' AND TEXT3 = 'C') C WHERE SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(CD_DATE,'YYYYMMDD'),1,6) BETWEEN B.LAST_MONTH AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMM') AND RECV_FLAG='FB' AND A.CLAIM_TYPE = C.CODE ) GROUP BY DS_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY DS_DEPT_NAME

/*getDashBoardList2*/ SELECT (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'VC01' AND CODE = X.CLAIM_TYPE) AS CLAIM_TEXT, X.DEPT_1, X.DEPT_2, X.DEPT_3, (X.DEPT_1+X.DEPT_2+X.DEPT_3) AS T_DEPT, X.CLAIM_TYPE FROM ( SELECT A.CLAIM_TYPE, NVL(SUM(DECODE(A.DS_DEPT, '048', 1, '042', 1, '008', 1, '009', 1)), 0) AS DEPT_1, NVL(SUM(DECODE(A.DS_DEPT, '017', 1, '114', 1, '118', 1)), 0) AS DEPT_2, NVL(SUM(DECODE(A.DS_DEPT, '112', 1, '113', 1, '122', 1, '123',1)), 0) AS DEPT_3 FROM KEPAVCDT A, (SELECT CODE FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'VC01' AND TEXT3 = 'C') B WHERE TO_CHAR(A.CD_DATE,'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN #{st_from_date} AND #{st_to_date} AND A.CLAIM_TYPE = B.CODE GROUP BY A.CLAIM_TYPE ) X ORDER BY CLAIM_TEXT

/*getDashBoardList4*/ SELECT (SELECT TEXT1 FROM V_VOC_ICOMCOD2 WHERE COMPANY_CODE = 'KRKORE0001' AND TYPE = 'C001' AND CODE = X.DS_DEPT AND SYS_TYPE='KA') DS_DEPT_NAME, X.DATE_0, X.DATE_1, X.DATE_2, X.DATE_3, (X.DATE_0+X.DATE_1+X.DATE_2+X.DATE_3) AS T_DATE, X.DS_DEPT FROM ( SELECT A.DS_DEPT, (NVL(SUM(DECODE(ROUND(SYSDATE-A.CD_DATE,0),0,1)),0)+ NVL(SUM(DECODE(ROUND(SYSDATE-A.CD_DATE,0),1,1)),0)) AS DATE_0, (NVL(SUM(DECODE(ROUND(SYSDATE-A.CD_DATE,0),2,1)),0)+ NVL(SUM(DECODE(ROUND(SYSDATE-A.CD_DATE,0),3,1)),0)) AS DATE_1, (NVL(SUM(DECODE(ROUND(SYSDATE-A.CD_DATE,0),4,1)),0)+ NVL(SUM(DECODE(ROUND(SYSDATE-A.CD_DATE,0),5,1)),0)) AS DATE_2, SUM(DECODE(ROUND(SYSDATE-A.CD_DATE,0)-6-ABS(ROUND(SYSDATE-A.CD_DATE,0)-6),0,1,0)) AS DATE_3 FROM KEPAVCDT A, (SELECT CODE FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'VC01' AND TEXT3 = 'C') B WHERE TO_CHAR(A.CD_DATE,'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN #{st_from_date} AND #{st_to_date} AND A.RECV_FLAG IN ('DC','PS') AND A.CLAIM_TYPE = B.CODE GROUP BY A.DS_DEPT ) X ORDER BY DS_DEPT_NAME
